title: ಮಲ್ಲಣ್ಣ ಕೇಳ್ತಾನೆ #10: ಕಸದ ಲೆಕ್ಕ | Only 26% of garbage processed #Shorts
description:
ಮಲ್ಲಣ್ಣ ಕೇಳ್ತಾನೆ, ಸಂಚಿಕೆ 10: ಕಸದ ಲೆಕ್ಕ. ಸಿಎಜಿ ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸಿದ ನಗರಗಳು ಸಂಗ್ರಹಿಸಿದ ಕಸದಲ್ಲಿ ಕೇವಲ 26% ಸಂಸ್ಕರಿಸಿದವು.

Mallanna Asks, episode 10: the garbage account. (Fictional characters; every figure is real.)
- The national auditor (CAG) found test-checked towns processed only 26% of the waste they collected (2012-13 to 2016-17).
- 6,935 of 8,324 km of roads (83%) were not swept daily.
- Rs 93.19 crore of waste-management money sat unspent at the end of March 2017.
- In Nanjangud, trucks without working GPS dumped waste near the bank of the River Kabini.
- Posts short: Environment Engineers 32%, Health Inspectors 70%, sanitation workers (pourakarmikas) 65%.
- In October 2022 the National Green Tribunal set Rs 2,900 crore as environmental compensation for solid and liquid waste.
- Indore has been India's cleanest city for 8 years; Mysuru is in the 2024-25 Super Swachh League.
The audit years were mostly under the Congress government; the NGT penalty came under the BJP government.

What you can do: complain on the Swachhata app; file an RTI for your ward's garbage collected vs processed. Look up your MLA: https://jarvisss007.github.io/know-your-mla

Sources: CAG Report No. 4 of 2018 (Solid Waste Management in ULBs, Karnataka); National Green Tribunal order, Oct 2022 (PTI); Swachh Survekshan 2024-25 results.
Every figure comes from a public record. If one is wrong, tell us and we will correct it. Music: original.

title: ಮಲ್ಲಣ್ಣ ಕೇಳ್ತಾನೆ #13: 1,452 ಕೆರೆ → 194 | Where Bengaluru's lakes went #Shorts
description:
ಮಲ್ಲಣ್ಣ ಕೇಳ್ತಾನೆ, ಸಂಚಿಕೆ 13: ಬೆಂಗಳೂರಿನಲ್ಲಿ 1,452 ಕೆರೆಗಳಿದ್ದವು; 2016ಕ್ಕೆ 194.

Mallanna Asks, episode 13. (Fictional characters; every figure is real.)
- The national auditor (CAG), citing an IISc study: Bengaluru had 1,452 water bodies holding 35 TMC in the early 1800s; by 2016, 194, with only 1.2 TMC usable after silting.
- 780 MLD of sewage flows into the stormwater drains.
- BBMP had taken no action on 714 of 2,626 identified drain encroachments.
- Rs 83.59 crore of central (JNNURM) assistance was lost because works were left incomplete.
The audit years were under the Congress government (2013-18); the report was tabled in 2021 under the BJP government.

What you can do: ask for your area's lake and drain encroachment list. Look up your MLA: https://jarvisss007.github.io/know-your-mla

title: ಎತ್ತಿನಹೊಳೆ: ₹15,297 ಕೋಟಿ ಖರ್ಚು, ಕೋಲಾರಕ್ಕೆ ನೀರಿಲ್ಲ | Yettinahole: Rs 15,297 cr #Shorts
description:
ಎತ್ತಿನಹೊಳೆ ಕುಡಿಯುವ ನೀರಿನ ಯೋಜನೆ: ಮಾರ್ಚ್ 2024ರ ವೇಳೆಗೆ ₹15,297 ಕೋಟಿ ಖರ್ಚು. 12 ವರ್ಷವಾದರೂ ಯೋಜನೆ ಕಾರ್ಯಾರಂಭ ಮಾಡಿಲ್ಲ ಎಂದು ಸಿಎಜಿ ವರದಿ. ಕೋಲಾರ, ಚಿಕ್ಕಬಳ್ಳಾಪುರಕ್ಕೆ ಇನ್ನೂ ನೀರು ತಲುಪಿಲ್ಲ.

Yettinahole drinking water project: Rs 15,297 crore spent by March 2024, and the national auditor (CAG) found it "could not be made operational even after 12 years". Its water has still not reached Kolar and Chikkaballapura; the government's own target is the end of 2027. Approved at Rs 8,324 crore in 2012, revised to Rs 23,252 crore in 2023. No project report ever fixed a completion date. 80% of works were awarded without checking whether bidders could do the job; 67% of the work by value went to seven contractors. By August 2026, 20 of 54 work packages were complete. Every government since 2012, BJP, Congress and coalition, has run it.

Know your MLA: https://jarvisss007.github.io/know-your-mla

Sources: CAG performance audit of the Yettinahole project (Report No. 10, tabled January 2026); Karnataka government statement, 20 August 2026; Chief Minister's 2027 target.
Every figure comes from a public record. If one is wrong, tell us and we will correct it. Music: original.

title: 97% of Karnataka's MLAs are crorepatis. 36 doubled their wealth in one term #Shorts
description:
97% of Karnataka's MLAs are crorepatis: 204 of the 210 whose affidavits are archived. The middle MLA declares about Rs 18 crore, and 29 declare more than Rs 100 crore. The 81 MLAs who won in both 2018 and 2023 saw average declared assets rise from Rs 39.7 crore to Rs 69.4 crore in one term; 36 of them at least doubled their wealth. To be fair, much of the rise is land they already owned, now valued higher, which is legal. And it is the same in every party.

title: Bengaluru: six years with no elected city council | Mallanna Asks #Shorts
description:
Mallanna and Kaveri ask: when does Bengaluru get an elected council?
Your village panchayat gets elections. Bengaluru does not.

• No elected city council since September 2020: six years with no corporator for any ward
• The city's annual development grant rose from Rs 3,000 crore to Rs 7,000 crore

Both governments: the BJP government did not hold the election from 2020 to 2023. The Congress government has not held it since 2023.

title: Karnataka's Health Department: 32,870 posts vacant, almost half | Mallanna Asks #Shorts
description:
Mallanna and Kaveri look at Karnataka's empty posts.
Is there a doctor at your local hospital?

• Health Department: 32,870 of 69,915 sanctioned posts vacant (47%), December 2024
• The 2026-27 budget gives health 4.3% of spending, against an average of 6.2% across states
• Primary teacher posts: 26% vacant in 2021-22, 25.5% in December 2025
• MLAs' basic pay rose from Rs 25,000 to Rs 80,000 (in 2022 and 2025, both times without debate)

To be fair: two governments, almost no change. Infant deaths fell from 23 to 14 per 1,000 births (2018 to 2023), below the national 25.

description:
ಮಲ್ಲಣ್ಣ ಕೇಳ್ತಾನೆ, ಸಂಚಿಕೆ 1. ಐದು ವರ್ಷಕ್ಕೊಮ್ಮೆ ಮನೆ ಬಾಗಿಲಿಗೆ ಬರುವ ನಾಯಕ, ಉಡುಗೊರೆ ಚೀಲ, ಉಚಿತ ಯೋಜನೆಗಳು, ಮತ್ತು ಅದರ ಬಿಲ್ ಯಾರು ಕಟ್ಟುತ್ತಾರೆ? ಕೆಲಸ ತೋರಿಸಿ, ಆಮೇಲೆ ಮತ.

Mallanna Asks, episode 1. A politician who visits once every five years, a bag of gifts, free schemes, and the question: who pays the bill? (Fictional characters; every figure is real.)
- Rs 375.61 crore of cash, liquor, gold and gifts was seized in Karnataka's 2023 election, 4.5 times 2018 (Election Commission).
- Giving or taking anything for a vote is a crime for both: up to one year in jail or a fine (Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, sections 170 and 173). A promise of public policy is not bribery.
- The five guarantee schemes cost Rs 51,286 crore in the 2026-27 budget (PRS). The revenue account went from a Rs 13,496 crore surplus in 2022-23 to a Rs 25,449 crore deficit in 2025-26, and the state owes contractors Rs 36,136 crore. 59% of revenue goes on salaries, pensions and interest.
- MLAs' basic pay: Rs 25,000 to Rs 80,000 (2022 and 2025). The 81 MLAs re-elected in 2023: average declared assets from Rs 39.7 crore to Rs 69.4 crore.
Free schemes are a legal policy choice. Cash for votes is a crime. Both cost you.

description:
ಮಲ್ಲಣ್ಣ ಕೇಳ್ತಾನೆ #9: ಉತ್ತರ ಮತ್ತು ದಕ್ಷಿಣ

Namma Metro Phase 2: approved at Rs 26,405 crore in 2014 (due 2020), revised to Rs 40,425 crore in May 2025, last section now due 2027; top fare Rs 60 to Rs 90 (Feb 2025). Kalyana Karnataka board, 7 districts, 2013-14 to 2024-25: Rs 19,778 crore allocated, Rs 13,229 crore released, Rs 11,174 crore spent (state figures). CAG: Rs 387.52 crore of assistance lost because funds went unused (the government disputes this), 3,731 works worth Rs 738.65 crore cancelled. Income per person grew 47.96% in Kalaburagi vs 74.84% statewide (2013-14 to 2019-20). Yadgir has the highest child anaemia in the state (76%). To be fair: Article 371J (2013) gave the region reserved jobs, seats and its own board. Metro costs are shared by the Centre, the state and loans.

45,590 of 1,78,935 primary teacher posts vacant (25.5%, Dec 2025). Computers for teaching: 37.8% of government schools vs 84.3% of private (UDISE+ 2025-26). Government school enrolment down 17 lakh in 15 years. The CM's family trust (National Education Foundation; trustees include D.K. Shivakumar, D.K. Suresh and Aishwarya DKS Hegde) runs private institutions. In Nov 2026 she was reported saying: "More than teacher shortage, low efficiency is the problem." To be fair: 26% of these posts were vacant under the BJP in 2021-22 too. Aishwarya DKS Hegde has not been charged with anything; this video responds only to her public statement.
